speaker: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah
text: asked the Minister for Transport (a) what is the progress in the construction of the North-South Expressway; and (b) whether its completion deadline can be brought forward so that traffic conditions along the Central Expressway can be improved.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Dr Lam Pin Min) (for the Minister for Transport)
text: This timeline takes into account traffic conditions, the complexity of the project and the need to ensure construction works are carried out safely.

speaker: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah (Nee Soon)
text: The North-South Expressway was announced in 2008 and then it was stated that it will commence in 2017, this year.

speaker: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah (Nee Soon)
text: Because a lot of my residents in Yishun are finding that the CTE is jammed most of the time, so we are waiting for the North-South Expressway.

speaker: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah (Nee Soon)
text: The completion date announced at that time was 2023, and now it is 2026.

speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
text: As to the reason for the delay, I would like to explain to the Member that the North-South Corridor will run through heavily used roads and built-up areas and interface with multiple road and rail infrastructure, making the construction more complex.

speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
text: In fact, an advance engineering study has highlighted a major challenge for construction work at the section of the corridor's tunnel close to MRT lines.

speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
text: Hence, there are construction and engineering challenges that will require sophisticated construction methods to ensure that existing adjacent infrastructures are not affected as far as possible.

speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
text: Planning and construction will also have to be carefully executed without compromising safety standards.

speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
text: I would also like to address the Member's question on how we mitigate the congestion along the CTE while waiting for the North-South Expressway (NSE)'s completion.

speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
text: LTA has adopted several measures to mitigate the congestion.

speaker: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah
text: I think the Senior Minister of State did not answer my first question.

speaker: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah
text: I understood that not the whole North-South Expressway tender has been called.

speaker: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah
text: The Senior Minister of State mentioned eight out of the 16.

speaker: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah
text: So, which are the eight that have been called?

speaker: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah
text: Does it include the portion that will be serving the residents in Yishun?

speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
text: I do not at present have the details exactly which are the projects that have been called out of those that I have mentioned but I will be willing to share some of this information with the Member subsequently.
